summary: The diff introduces multiple new/changed backend and frontend behaviors (e.g., user profiles, separated admin vs personal storage, identity-scoped React Query cache handling, new admin-panel navigation/tabbing). The BuildRequest only asks to restore Draft Version 8 behavior, but the diff summary does not provide evidence that changes are a rollback to Version 8 rather than new functionality. As a result, REQ-1 cannot be verified as implemented and several changes look like unrequested feature additions/behavior changes.
